text: APPROVE: Moving the null/empty/equal-to-`dir` check into `ParentOrNull` removes the `||` sequence from `IsTemplateProject`, which should bring it from 16 to 15. The helper returns exactly what the old condition tested and `parent is null` breaks in the same cases, so behaviour is unchanged, and the null-flow and `string?` usage should compile cleanly. I could only see the diff, not the full file, so I'm assuming nullable is enabled and that `parent` is used after the check as before.
